content.title: Opening odds for Knicks vs. Hawks 2026 NBA playoffs Game 1
content.text: Skip to content Ciaran Doyle details the opening odds on DraftKings Sportsbook for Game 1 of the Knicks vs. Hawks 2026 NBA playoffs first-round series. Updated Apr 12, 2026 11:02 PM EDT NEW YORK, NEW YORK - APRIL 10: Karl-Anthony Towns #32 of the New York Knicks reacts after dunking the ball during the first quarter against the Toronto Raptors at Madison Square Garden on April 10, 2026 in New York City. (Photo by Pamela Smith/Getty Images) Audio By Carbonatix The NBA playoffs are just around the corner, and in the first round, we get an intriguing matchup between the #3 seed New York Knicks and the #6 seed Atlanta Hawks. Game 1 is set for either Saturday or Sunday in Madison Square Garden. Knicks vs. Hawks Game 1 Opening Odds Looking at the odds on DraftKings Sportsbookopens in a new tab, the Knicks are favorites to win Game 1 at -205 odds. The Hawks are +170 to get the upset road win. The spread is set at 5.5 points, while the over/under is listed at 217.5 points. These teams met up three times in the regular season, with New York winning two of the three. Both of New York’s wins were by three points, while Atlanta’s was by 12. What was interesting was that the road team won on all three occasions. Could we see that again this weekend?
